text:
Type: solid pine shelf for a shelving system
Use: extra shelf between uprights for books, boxes and pantry goods; living room, home office, garage
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: untreated solid pine with small knots, beige metal end rails
Colors: pale natural pine, warm light yellow, grey-beige
Shape: long narrow flat plank with square edges and slim metal fittings on each short end, plain and sturdy, low profile
Feel: natural, practical, warm, simple
Goes with: raw pine uprights, white walls, woven baskets, linen; Scandinavian, rustic or utility rooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Untreated solid wood is a durable natural material which is even more hardwearing and easy to look after if you oil or wax the surface.
